title: Evidence
description: How far the proof of a code finding went. `class` is one step of one ladder for all engines. A receipt is permitted only for the class `reproduced`, because only an execution makes a receipt. `verification` records an independent check that did not execute the claim, for example the blind verification of the public CLI.

evidenceClass.title: EvidenceClass
evidenceClass.description: The evidence ladder, from the strongest. `reproduced`: a check executed and showed the effect. `reachable`: a cited path from attacker input to the effect survived an adversarial review. `defective`: the code is defective, and an independent review agreed, but no path is proved. `suspected`: a model stated the claim and nothing confirmed it. A value that a mapping does not recognize maps to `suspected`, because that class claims nothing more than a statement.

receiptRef.title: ReceiptRef
receiptRef.description: A reference to the record of one execution: the format of the record and the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (keys sorted, no white space, UTF-8).

schema.description: The format of the receipt, for example `sentrytower-receipt-v1`.

uri.description: Where the receipt is kept, when it is kept outside the record that holds this reference.

verificationStatus.title: VerificationStatus
verificationStatus.description: `verified`: the check ran. `unverified`: the check failed, was refused or did not run (see `reason`). `none`: the engine does not check findings of this source. `unknown`: the source gave a status that a mapping did not recognize.

verificationOutcome.title: VerificationOutcome
verificationOutcome.description: What the check found. `supports`: the claim holds. `refutes`: a guard in the code stops the claim. `inconclusive`: the check could not decide. `unknown`: the source gave an outcome that a mapping did not recognize.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: An independent check of the claim that did not execute it.

method.description: How the check worked, for example `blind-vote`.

score.description: The score of the check from 0 (refuted) to 1 (supported), when the method gives one.
